tips_en: Read the humanoid motion-generation paper first: its combination of persistent recurrent memory, long-horizon controllability, and a 6.1× inference speedup is especially notable, with the G1 deployment providing compelling real-world validation. Embo-Harness is the closest conceptual companion because it likewise turns a generative model into a closed-loop controller, while WeMM-Ecom broadens the theme to domain specialization under real-world deployment constraints.
tips_zh: 建议先读人形运动生成论文：持久循环记忆、长时程可控生成与 6.1 倍推理加速构成其突出贡献，G1 实机部署也提供了有力验证。Embo-Harness 与之最接近，同样探索如何将生成模型构造成闭环控制器；WeMM-Ecom 则将主题拓展到实际部署约束下的领域专门化。
